ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the diagonal-line shading represents land, and the blank area represents ocean; a latitude line labeled 40° runs across the figure. A is located near the west coast of the shaded land, at a position close to the 40° latitude line, conforming to the distribution characteristic of the west coast of a continent at 30°—40°. Then reason: the typical climate on the west coast of a continent at 30°—40° is Mediterranean climate. The formation of Mediterranean climate depends on the seasonal movement of pressure belts and wind belts with the seasonal movement of the direct solar point, that is, in summer it is controlled by the subtropical high-pressure belt, and in winter it is influenced by the westerly belt. If the obliquity of the ecliptic becomes 0°, the direct solar point will no longer move north and south, the seasonal movement of pressure belts and wind belts will disappear, and the Mediterranean climate type with winter rain and summer dryness will no longer be able to form. Therefore place A belongs to Mediterranean climate.
